      About this item

      • India’s Biggest Battery Ever: Equipped with India’s biggest-ever 7300mAh ultra-capacity battery. Despite its size, the device remains ultra-slim at just 0.789cm and light at 199g. With 90W FlashCharge technology, power up in no time and enjoy longer usage without the wait.
      • Brightest Display: Enjoy an ultra-vivid viewing experience on the Flagship level Quad-Curved AMOLED display, reaching up to 5000 nits local peak brightness. Built tough, the Z10 is also military-grade certified for durability, combining beauty with resilience.
      • Exceptional Performance: The fastest* processor in the segment powered by Snapdragon 7s Gen3 mobile platform , built on a 4nm TSMC process, and delivering an impressive 820K+ AnTuTu score. The 12GB RAM variant doubles its memory with an additional 12GB of extended RAM for seamless multitasking.
      • Next-Level AI Camera: Capture every detail with the 50MP Sony IMX882 OIS camera, record in 4K at 30fps, and take stunning selfies with the 32MP wide-angle front camera. Powered by AI, features include AI Erase, AI Photo Enhance, AI Super Documents, AI Note Assist, AI Live Text, and the intuitive Circle to Search with Google.
      • Latest Software Experience: Runs on Funtouch OS 15, based on Android 15, offering a seamless experience with 2 years of Android updates, 3 years of security patches, *T&C apply

          I recently purchased the iQOO Z10 and have been using it for a few days now. Overall, it’s a solid mid-range device with good performance, a vibrant display, and decent battery life. The design feels premium and the UI runs smoothly even with multitasking and gaming.

          However, one noticeable drawback is the absence of Dolby Surround Sound support. In this price range, many competitors offer enhanced audio features, and the lack of Dolby support is a letdown—especially for users who stream movies, play games, or listen to music regularly. The speaker quality is decent, but it lacks depth and immersive quality without Dolby audio enhancement.

          Adding Dolby Atmos support in future models—or even via a software update if possible—would significantly improve the overall media experience and make the Z10 a much more compelling choice.

        About this Item

        • India’s Biggest Battery Ever: Equipped with India’s biggest-ever 7300mAh ultra-capacity battery. Despite its size, the device remains ultra-slim at just 0.789cm and light at 199g. With 90W FlashCharge technology, power up in no time and enjoy longer usage without the wait.
        • Brightest Display: Enjoy an ultra-vivid viewing experience on the Flagship level Quad-Curved AMOLED display, reaching up to 5000 nits local peak brightness. Built tough, the Z10 is also military-grade certified for durability, combining beauty with resilience.
        • Exceptional Performance: The fastest* processor in the segment powered by Snapdragon 7s Gen3 mobile platform , built on a 4nm TSMC process, and delivering an impressive 820K+ AnTuTu score. The 12GB RAM variant doubles its memory with an additional 12GB of extended RAM for seamless multitasking.
        • Next-Level AI Camera: Capture every detail with the 50MP Sony IMX882 OIS camera, record in 4K at 30fps, and take stunning selfies with the 32MP wide-angle front camera. Powered by AI, features include AI Erase, AI Photo Enhance, AI Super Documents, AI Note Assist, AI Live Text, and the intuitive Circle to Search with Google.
        • Latest Software Experience: Runs on Funtouch OS 15, based on Android 15, offering a seamless experience with 2 years of Android updates, 3 years of security patches, *T&C apply

        Product description

        Z10 features India’s biggest 7300mAh battery in a sleek 7.89mm, 199g design, powered by ultra-fast 90W FlashCharge. The Flagship level Quad-Curved AMOLED display delivers 5000 nits peak brightness and military-grade durability. Powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 (4nm) with an 820K+ AnTuTu score. Capture stunning shots with the 50MP Sony OIS camera, 32MP front camera, and smart AI tools like AI Erase, AI Enhance, AI Super documents & many more. Running on Funtouch OS 15 (Android 15), the Z10 promises 2 years of Android updates, 3 years of security patch update.
